BL-1856 — The merge-drop guard counts a repeated line before calling it lost - merge_drop_guard_lib.bb's lines-lost matches a side's removed and added lines by text alone, so Specification.MD's 400-odd identical "Prior entry —" separators make any merge that keeps the other side's new entries read as a resurrection (BL-1845's documenter send, 2026-10-01); a line text becomes a finding only when the merge's count of it differs from the side's own count plus the other side's net change of it
What it solves: ## Why
Approval context: Sign-off on narrowing what BL-1576's guard reports. FIRM: a line text is a finding only when the merge's count of that text differs from the side's own count plus the other side's net change of it. That clears the repeated-separator false positive that held BL-1845. Putting back the one copy a side…
BL-1856 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1856" (or "reject BL-1856 <reason>") to act.
